create_stand_task: create a DM Control humanoid_CMU stand task environment with a 20 second time limit
create_run_task: create a DM Control humanoid_CMU run task environment targeting 10 m/s horizontal speed
get_physics_head_height: get the head height of the humanoid_CMU physics simulation from the z position
get_physics_com_velocity: get the center of mass velocity from the humanoid_CMU physics sensor data
get_humanoid_observation: get an egocentric observation dict with joint angles, extremities, and torso orientation
